fields.name: duration
fields.title: Duration
fields.description: Duration of the generated video in seconds.

fields.name: reasoning_level
fields.title: Reasoning Level
fields.description: How much effort the harness spends reasoning about the given prompt. Higher reasoning effort means slower generation time.

fields.name: aspect_ratio
fields.title: Aspect Ratio
fields.description: Aspect ratio of the generated video. `auto` uses 16:9 for text prompts and follows the first image otherwise.

fields.name: generate_audio
fields.title: Generate Audio
fields.description: Whether to generate audio for the video.

fields.name: seed
fields.title: Seed
fields.description: The seed to use for the generation. Random when not provided.
